name: mainnet-ttl-bound
description: B2 at mainnet's value: a certificate whose TTL sits exactly at mainnet's bound — height + TTL_MAX, with TTL_MAX = 240 rather than devnet's 32 — and is applied. The corpus's other TTL vector uses an immortal TTL on devnet, which is rejected under any value of the bound and so pins none of them; this one is accepted only by an implementation carrying mainnet's number and reading the comparison as inclusive. One off either way and the block's verdict flips.
